survivors.claim: A single causal visibility/commit fabric spanning cognitive state and re-entry reduces cross-surface partial-state defects relative to separately durable semantic surfaces.
survivors.counterhypothesis: Existing component contracts plus local transactions already suffice.
survivors.falsifier: matched fault matrix shows no defect/recovery difference.

survivors.claim: Separating monotone evidence from non-monotone belief/goal/reward deltas preserves useful observations during abort/recovery without exposing unverified outcome-conditioned state.
survivors.counterhypothesis: Task-wide transactions are simpler and performance difference is negligible.
survivors.falsifier: real workload shows no material barrier/latency reduction or classification is unreliable.

survivors.claim: Binding GWT/Hyperposition branches to transaction and causal-parent identity improves causal re-entry tests and targeted invalidation.
survivors.counterhypothesis: Current receiver/selection receipts already provide equivalent observability.
survivors.falsifier: truthful/shuffled/no-reentry/lesion tests gain no attribution precision.

survivors.claim: A consistent-cut certificate spanning state epoch, lease epoch and unresolved effects makes restart/recovery more mechanically decidable.
survivors.counterhypothesis: Component-local recovery receipts are more modular and equally safe.
survivors.falsifier: fault sweeps show equal safety with less overhead for local receipts.

survivors.claim: Removing direct canonical writes from cognitive organs materially reduces semantic split-brain risk and simplifies replay.
survivors.counterhypothesis: The indirection and delta bookkeeping create more defects than they prevent.
survivors.falsifier: mutation inventory/fuzzing and target-VPS benchmarks show higher complexity without lower failure rate.

selected: ACEF-H2-A+B+C+D+E as one coupled candidate; individual claims remain separately lesionable
